subject: Next steps: buying junction map + who signs contracts at Novacare
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@novacare.com>, Alice Park <alice.park@novacare.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0500
Subject: Quick recap + who owns what on your side (procurement / security / econ buyer)

Jordan — thanks again for the call today. Short recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- What we heard: Novacare wants to evaluate Redwood for a patient-facing summarization feature. Primary concerns are PHI handling, SLA for latency during peak hours, and integration with your ETL pipeline.
- Business driver: reduce human summarization time and triage cost. You estimated ~80k monthly summaries initially.

As discussed, to move from technical POC -> procurement we need a quick map of three things on your side:
1) Economic owner who signs off on budget/commit (name + title + preferred cadence for decision)
2) Security/compliance contact for SOC2/PHI review (to start a pre-sales questionnaire)
3) Procurement/legal contact for contract routing and standard timelines (redlines, PO cadence)

Could you share a one-slide org roster or even just a short list (name, role, email) for those 3 lanes? If easier, a PDF or an exported org-chart is perfect.

Internal next steps from us: Priyom will prepare a tailored mutual action plan and a short SOW draft; Karthik will scope the infra footprint for the POC and confirm whether private deployment or dedicated is the better initial approach.

Attachments: short exec-summary (PDF) and a mutual-action-template (xlsx) — they're attached for your review.

Proposed timing: if we can get the roster by EOD Monday (16th), we can have a first-draft MAM and SOW over to Procurement by Wednesday.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: redwood_exec-summary-novacare.pdf (application/pdf), mutual_action_plan_NOV-4582.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@novacare.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Park <alice.park@novacare.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novacare.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 08:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick recap + who owns what on your side (procurement / security / econ buyer)

Thanks, Evelyn — great call yesterday. I pulled together what I can quickly:

- Economic owner: Monica Trent (Chief Product Officer) — monica.trent@novacare.com — she owns budget for patient experience projects. She prefers a single decision meeting with relevant stakeholders rather than iterative approvals.
- Security contact: Alice Park (security director) — alice.park@novacare.com — she handles PHI vendor onboarding. She's copied.
- Procurement: procurement@novacare.com — they handle contracts; typically require a PO + 30-day review for standard SaaS terms.

Two clarifications / asks from our side before I share full org chart: 
1) Can you confirm whether Redwood requires any on-prem data connectors during POC (we prefer not to grant PHI access to external systems for initial evaluation)?
2) What are the standard SLA and data residency options (US-only, multi-region) — Alice may want the high-level doc before completing the questionnaire.

I'll try to share a simple org roster PDF this afternoon.

—Jordan
Jordan Lee
Senior Product Manager — Care Experience
Novacare Health

Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick recap + who owns what on your side (procurement / security / econ buyer)

Evelyn / Jordan — happy to help. A couple quick points from security: 

- We will not provide PHI to a vendor until a BAA is in place AND we have completed a basic security assessment (SIG Lite or your internal questionnaire).
- For an initial POC we are open to a pseudo-PHI dataset (anonymized synthetic set) hosted in our AWS account; we expect clear instructions on data ingestion and deletion after the POC.
- Residency: US-only data storage is required for patient data.

Please send the SOC2 summary, your data deletion policy, and a short note on whether Redwood can run strictly within our VPC during the POC (we understand that may require a private deployment / short-term environment). If you have a standard BAA template we can review, attach it.

Thanks — Alice
Alice Park
Director, Information Security
Novacare Health

On Sun, Nov 15, 2026 at 08:07, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@novacare.com> wrote:

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@novacare.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@novacare.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novacare.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick recap + who owns what on your side (procurement / security / econ buyer) — next steps

Alice / Jordan — great, thanks for the fast responses and context. Brief updates and requests so we can hand this cleanly to Procurement and Security: 

1) On POC data approach: we can absolutely run the POC against a synthetic dataset in your AWS account (no PHI ingress to Redwood systems) and provide a short runbook for ingestion/deletion. Karthik will own the runbook and outline the infra we propose for the POC.
2) Docs to attach: I am attaching a SOC2 summary, our BAA template, and a one-page data handling note. If you prefer the BAA redline, let procurement know and we'll route to legal.
3) Economic owner: we'll loop Monica for a single decision meeting. Jordan — can you introduce Monica to this thread or send a 1-paragraph intro? That will speed scheduling.
4) Procurement timeline: once Novacare confirms the econ owner and procurement contact, Priyom will push a mutual action plan and an initial SOW; our usual procurement review window (for customers this size) is ~2–3 weeks from final SOW receipt.

Next steps (proposed):
- Jordan: send org roster + intro to Monica by EOD today if possible.
- Alice: confirm whether SIG-Lite or your internal questionnaire is preferred and we will prioritize that.
- Procurement: confirm any required contract language (PO terms, indemnity caps) that would block an initial demo.

I'll mark these in HubSpot and share the mutual action plan draft once I have Monica on thread.

Appreciate it — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
